units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 18a">B. Mets. 18ᵃ</cite> a letter of divorce was found in which was written, <he>בש׳ מתא וכ׳</he> at Sh. (which is) a place on the river (or canal) Rakhis.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 18b:1">Ib.ᵇ</cite> top <he>חיישינן לשני ש׳</he> we must apprehend the existence of two places by the name of Sh.
